subject: Recap + MAP: Redwood demo & POC next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Miles <jordan@acme.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@acme.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + MAP: Redwood demo & POC next steps

Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciate the clear context on the model-driven feature you're prioritizing. Quick recap from our call and suggested mutual action plan (MAP) so we're aligned on next steps and owners.

Key pain points you shared
- Production latency spikes at peak (95th/99th percentile) causing poor UX for your agents
- Inference unit cost is higher than expected for the generative assistant use case
- Security/compliance constraints for customer data (PII/PHI) require stronger controls and auditability
- Need confidence that model quality (responses) won't regress once we optimize quantization/batching

Goals you described
- Reduce inference unit cost by ~35-50% without losing quality
- 95th/99th P50 latency target under 200ms for the primary agent flows
- Validate a Private deployment option (VPC/on-prem) for regulated data
- Complete a technical POC and decision within ~6 weeks

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (high level) — attachments: Redwood_MAP_Template.xlsx (stub), Redwood_Security_Summary.pdf (stub)
1) Technical deep-dive + perf baseline (Jul 23–Jul 30)
   - Owner: Marissa Cole (Redwood) / Jordan Miles (Acme)
   - Deliverable: baseline latency + cost report on a representative workload
2) Security & compliance review (Jul 23–Aug 6)
   - Owner: Rishi Malhotra (Redwood, security lead) / Priya Sharma (Acme)
   - Deliverable: SOC2 evidence, network diagram, KMS integration notes
3) POC deployment (Aug 2–Aug 20)
   - Owner: Dylan Brooks (Redwood solutions) / Acme engineering POC lead (TBD)
   - Deliverable: running POC instance (hosted/dedicated/private), sample traffic, cost/latency dashboard
4) Decision & next steps (Aug 23)
   - Owner: Jordan + Acme procurement/legal + Redwood account team

Immediate next steps
- Jordan / Priya: confirm POC engineering contact and preferred environment (hosted vs VPC).
- I'll share a filled MAP (template attached) with milestone dates and owners.
- Rishi will send the security summary and SOC2 references (attached) and can join the security deep-dive.

If this looks right I'll update the attached MAP to reflect the dates above and send a calendar invite for the technical deep-dive (proposing Jul 23 10:00 AM PT).

Thanks — looking forward to moving quickly on this.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0149

Marissa —

Thanks for the thorough recap. That matches our notes from today. A few quick updates from our side:

- Confirming objectives: cost reduction target is accurate and the latency SLA (95th < 200ms) is what our Product needs to see in the POC.
- Security: Priya will lead the security review. I'll loop in our SOC team if needed but she has the primary ownership.
- POC engineering contact: please loop in Samir Patel (samir.patel@acme.com) — he's our SRE lead and will own the integration work.
- Timeline: the 6-week decision window works but can we push the kickoff by one day to Jul 24 for internal calendar reasons?

I've copied Samir on a separate thread to introduce him to the plan. If you can update the MAP with Samir as the POC owner and shift the kickoff to Jul 24, that would be great.

Jordan
